title: Score Sheet
body:
Syntax: score

Description: An overview of every 'score' sheet section not already covered by 'help attributes' or 'help combatstats'.

&CRank&x - Your current village rank (e.g. Genin), raised through missions and time in service.
  &G[Active]&x

&CClan&x - A family affiliation chosen at creation, or changed later with 'clan join'.
  &R[Not Yet Implemented -- cosmetic only, no mechanical bonus yet]&x

&CLevel / Experience&x - Your overall combat level and progress toward the next one, gained from defeating enemies and completing missions.
  &G[Active]&x

&CRyo&x - Your spendable currency, earned from missions, corpses, and jobs, spent at shops and on crafting materials.
  &G[Active]&x

&CHealth / Chakra / Stamina&x - Your combat resources. Health reaching 0 defeats you; jutsu cost Chakra; physical actions cost Stamina. All three regenerate naturally over time, faster while resting.
  &G[Active]&x

&CPosition / Fighting&x - Whether you're standing, sitting, or resting, and who (if anyone) you're currently fighting.
  &G[Active]&x

&CPractice Points / Training Points&x - How many skill-practice and attribute-training uses you have banked right now (see 'help attributes').
  &G[Active]&x

&CPlayer Kills / Deaths&x - Your PvP record.
  &G[Active]&x

&CTotal Play Time&x - How long you've spent logged in and playing.
  &G[Active]&x

&D(See also: 'help attributes', 'help combatstats', 'help jobs')&x

Date: 2026-08-17
